text: An official MOE news article on exception procedures for American-curriculum graduates describes 'MSAT Math' and 'IELTS/English MSAT' as accepted alternatives to SAT Math and TOEFL respectively. This confirms that a SAT Math score and a TOEFL score are part of the baseline equivalency requirement for American-curriculum Grade 12 certificates, though the article itself does not state the exact baseline passing thresholds.
label: OFFICIAL

text: Secondary-sourced baseline thresholds for American-curriculum Grade 12 equivalency: SAT Math >= 450 (or EmSAT Achieve Math >= 500 as an alternative route), and TOEFL iBT >= 61 (or IELTS Academic >= 5.0, or EmSAT English >= 1100 as alternative routes). These numbers come from a translated copy of Ministerial Decision No. 199 of 2019 hosted on ibo.org (not moe.gov.ae/u.ae directly, and from 2019 -- not confirmed still current), and are corroborated by an independent source: GEMS American Academy Abu Dhabi's own admissions guide states the identical thresholds for UAE-resident American-curriculum applicants. Not confirmed on an official MOE or u.ae page in this session -- treat as provisional/ASSUMED, not VERIFIED, and say so explicitly if used to compute an eligibility verdict.
label: ASSUMPTION

text: Numeric thresholds commonly cited for British-curriculum equivalency (e.g. a minimum number of A-level or AS-level passes, plus a minimum number of GCSE/IGCSE passes at a given grade) appear only on secondary aggregator/consultancy sites.
